status: Checked executable-section digest control implemented; fresh native Windows execution remains required.

observed_failure.interpretation: Windows rejected the altered DOS-stub image. The test incorrectly required this structural mutation to reach the image-digest comparison. This observation is not evidence that a changed signed image was accepted.
observed_failure.earlier_checks: Signing, verification of the original file against the pinned certificate, and rejection of the wrong certificate pin completed before this control. The failure stopped the remaining file loop.

change.legacy_control: The byte-64 mutation remains a separate categorical rejection check. It contributes no BAD_DIGEST evidence.
change.digest_control: A read-only PE32/PE32+ selector validates DOS/PE/COFF headers, bounded optional header and data directories, complete section table, SizeOfHeaders, aligned bounded certificate table, and nonoverlapping bounded raw section ranges. It selects a byte inside a nonempty raw section having both code and executable characteristics, outside all headers and before the certificate table. The original and modified certificate blobs must remain identical.
change.strict_policy: The selected executable-byte mutation must produce exactly TRUST_E_BAD_DIGEST. TRUST_E_NOSIGNATURE, another error, or successful verification still fails. Original-file verification, exact certificate pinning and wrong-pin rejection remain in the same signing loop. No trust-store or verification-policy bypass was added.
change.test_inventory: No test names or counts were added. Portable parser controls are folded into the existing ReleaseIdentity case; its Windows branch still signs and verifies the real compiled executables.

local_evidence.result: The existing literal offset assertion rejected a temporary selector returning byte 64.
